note: A grouped reporting version whose codes all sit in the detailed book stays unbound, without an issue: a label rule binds by the source's version label, never by code coincidence. A pooled edition's listed label binds too, over its whole pooled range like pooled coding (Y-207): POOLED. Pooled evidence loses to explicit coverage as in occurrence resolution (Y-202): MIXED's explicit 2017 binds with its own evidence only.
fails_if: `_label_rule_bindings` (source_classification_bindings.py) binds a book to a segment whose value-set version label is not in its `value_set_labels` (for example by code containment), so GROUPED ('Grouped report') is also bound to a; or it reads an occurrence's window with `scope_bounds`, which leaves a pooled scope unbounded, instead of `occurrence_bounds`, so POOLED and MIXED's pooled 2016 and 2018 bind nothing (the defect that left all 4,582 pooled real-seed states unbound); or `_column_evidence` stops clipping a pooled window to the spans no explicit occurrence covers, so MIXED's explicit 2017 issue also cites the pooled edition 1618

sources.description: SCB DETAILED and GROUPED each carry codes 1/2 under the value-set versions 'Detailed book' and 'Grouped report'; book a. POOLED carries codes 1/2 under 'Detailed book' in the pooled edition '2016 - 2018' only. MIXED carries codes 1/3 under 'Detailed book' in the same pooled edition and in the explicit 2017.
